canada.geo-ca.name: GEO.ca (Canadian Geospatial Data Infrastructure)
canada.geo-ca.summary: National discovery portal of the Canadian Geospatial Data Infrastructure, searching federal, provincial and municipal geospatial data and services.

canada.geonova.name: GeoNOVA
canada.geonova.summary: Nova Scotia's gateway to provincial mapping, including LiDAR elevation, orthophotos, topographic base data and civic addresses.
canada.geonova.attribution: Contains information obtained under license from the Province of Nova Scotia which is provided without warranty or liability for errors or omissions.

useStatus.restricted: Commercial use is not clearly allowed: Province of Nova Scotia Restricted Geographic Services License

canada.nwt-centre-for-geomatics.name: NWT Centre for Geomatics
canada.nwt-centre-for-geomatics.summary: The Northwest Territories' geomatics centre: satellite imagery, base mapping and territorial datasets for an area where national data is sparse.

canada.saskatchewan-geohub.name: Saskatchewan GeoHub
canada.saskatchewan-geohub.summary: The Provincial Office of Geomatics Coordination hub, with Saskatchewan boundaries, land, resources and imagery layers.

useStatus.restricted: Commercial use is not clearly allowed: Service licence note (SGIC)

layers.name: Nova Scotia, Canada: GeoNOVA
layers.summary: Nova Scotia Orthophotomap Database (NSODB) 1:10,000 colour orthophotos, most current per area (rolling; GeoNOVA news cites 2024 eastern and 2025 southwestern updates).

layers.name: Northwest Territories, Canada: NWT Centre for Geomatics
layers.summary: NWT air photo compilation (communities and corridors, <1 m), 1937-2023 (mosaic time extent; most recent on top by default).

layers.name: Saskatchewan, Canada: Saskatchewan GeoHub
layers.summary: SGIC public orthophotos (province-wide RGB air photo mosaic), 2008-2021/22 (mosaic time extent).
